description: Planted vulnerabilities in public intentionally-vulnerable applications, read from their source by hand. 'in_taxonomy': false marks a planted flaw whose class had no detector at the time; all current entries are in the taxonomy since ADR-023. Clone each repository at the pinned commit; never run the code. 'held_out': true marks applications added after the detectors were designed: their truth lists were written BEFORE the scanner was run on them and no detector was tuned on them before the first score. 'held_out': 'third' marks the third batch (VAmPI, dvpwa, nodejs-goof, vulnerable-node, dvws-node): truth lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them. 'clean_files' list files that must produce no finding (negatives). 'held_out': 'fourth' marks the fourth batch (lets-be-bad-guys, django.nV, Tiredful-API, vulnpy): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. 'held_out': 'fifth' marks Pixi, DVSA and crAPI (workshop service): lists written and committed before the scanner was run; no detector changed. 'held_out': 'sixth' marks the sixth batch (skf-labs python labs, DVGA, Damn-Vulnerable-RESTaurant): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. 'held_out': 'seventh' marks the seventh batch (videvelopers/Vulnerable-Flask-App, VitthalS/ivna, samoylenko/vulnerable-app-nodejs-express): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. 'held_out': 'eighth' marks the eighth batch (payatu/vuln-nodejs-app, 4auvar/VulnNodeApp): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. Both deliberately test deep cross-file indirection (route -> controller -> model, or route -> helper util) between the request read and the sink. 'held_out': 'ninth' marks the ninth batch (michealkeines/Vulnerable-API, devopslifter/Expense-Reimbursement-API, jorritfolmer/vulnerable-api): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. VAPI-folmer deliberately mixes connexion path-param handlers (request data arrives as a function argument, already supported) with connexion.request.get_json()/.headers (a request access qualified by the connexion module, not flask's bare 'request' name) to test whether that alias is recognised as a source. 'held_out': 'tenth' marks the tenth batch (manuelz120/extremely-vulnerable-flask-app, R-Rothrock/testing-sites): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. Both were picked to test specific hypotheses from ADR-031 (cross-file sink) and ADR-034 (a value assigned in one branch of a plain if/else, used after it, not carrying taint) rather than being a random sample. 'held_out': 'eleventh' marks the eleventh batch (Ayodub/leaky-flask, szelaya8/vulnerable-node, austimkelly/swiss-cheese): lists written and committed before the scanner was run on them; no detector was changed for them. Every line below was checked against a direct scan_repo run before freezing (ADR-036's lesson), not just read from source.
